premises.text: Developers spend much of the week in toil from complexity, which wastes hours, costs businesses, and drives unhappy developer attrition
premises.evidence_span: developers spend half their week in toil. Toil is the tedious work in software creation that arises from complexity

premises.text: Observability, monitoring, and security stacks bury developers in tool mazes away from coding while hunting performance and security fixes
premises.evidence_span: Developers toil in mountains of data, looking for information to fix performance issues, remediate security flaws, and rework broken code. Developers are lost in a maze of tools they don't control

premises.text: AppMap delivers personal observability with runtime performance and security analysis inside the code editor as developers write code
premises.evidence_span: AppMap delivers personal observability, performance, and security analysis to developers when they work to reduce toil. And AppMap is in the tool developers love the most, their code editor

premises.text: AppMaps capture accurate runtime behavior across environments including uncommitted code, data stores, and service boundaries—not static analysis
premises.evidence_span: App maps are accurate, up-to-date, runtime information about the behavior of software as it is at any moment for any environment

premises.text: Automatic analysis alerts on issues such as N+1 performance queries and broken access-control security flaws while coding
premises.evidence_span: AppMap automatically analyzes this information to find issues why developers work, and it alerts them if it finds a problem

premises.text: Deep language/framework integration and open source enable community expansion; maps are shareable and report fixes for org tracking
premises.evidence_span: AppMap integrates deeply with popular languages and frameworks. And AppMap is open source to integrate with new languages and new communities

premises.text: Runtime editor insights can accelerate adoption of other developer tools, exemplified by Postman OpenAPI sync
premises.evidence_span: AppMap generates open API data in the code editor and syncs it automatically with Postman collections

premises.text: Free for individuals, students, and open source via VS Code and JetBrains marketplaces, with partnering for developer-focused organizations
premises.evidence_span: AppMap is free for individuals, students, and open source projects from the VS Code and JetBrains marketplaces

value.text: Reduce developer toil so teams ship more performant, secure, reliable code faster
value.evidence_span: AppMap helps development teams reduce toil and ship more performant, secure, and reliable code faster

causal_links.evidence_span: AppMap automatically analyzes this information to find issues why developers work, and it alerts them if it finds a problem
Toil robs 25 million developers of the joy of coding
software developers can see the behavior of their software as they write code
runtime data in the code editor can accelerate adoption of developer tools from inside the code editor

notes: Performance and security demo findings treated as cascade examples of automatic analysis (P5), not separate premises. Adoption metrics and marketplace ratings excluded as traction. Free individual tier plus partner motion coded as distribution (P8). Anti-template: problem, product, distribution separately revisable.
